info.title: OpenHIM Core API
info.description: The administrative API of OpenHIM (Open Health Information Mediator), the OpenHIE interoperability layer that routes, persists and audits health messages between systems. The API is served over HTTPS on port 8080 and covers channels, clients, roles, users, transactions, rerun tasks, mediators, metrics, audits, logs, events, visualisers, the keystore and metadata import/export. The OpenFn openhim adaptor wraps a handful of these (transactions, clients, channels, tasks) and otherwise exposes generic http.get/post/put/_delete helpers, so any endpoint here is reachable from a job. Records are MongoDB documents keyed by a 24-hex `_id`; list endpoints return bare JSON arrays and most create/update/delete endpoints answer with a plain-text confirmation message rather than JSON.

post.description: This is NOT a Core API endpoint. It is a channel `urlPattern` served by the OpenHIM router (ports 5000/5001 on a real deployment) and forwarded to a mediator; it is documented here because the openhim adaptor ships a `createEncounter` operation that posts to this exact path. The payload and response shape are whatever the mediator behind the channel accepts, so no fields are asserted.

schema.description: Encounter payload, as accepted by the mediator behind the channel.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic authentication, when the `basic` type is enabled.

tokenAuth.name: auth-token
tokenAuth.description: Deprecated token scheme: send `auth-username`, `auth-ts`, `auth-salt` and `auth-token` (sha512 of the salt plus the password hash and timestamp).

Route.description: An upstream endpoint a channel forwards to. HTTP and Kafka routes are supported.

cert.description: Client certificate from the keystore, for mutual TLS.

secured.description: Use TLS to reach the route.

path.description: Fixed path to send to, instead of the incoming path.

pathTransform.description: sed-style transform applied to the incoming path.

primary.description: The route whose response is returned to the client.

ChannelAlert.description: An alerting rule on a channel.

status.description: Transaction status to match, e.g. `404` or `5xx`.

RewriteRule.description: A URL rewrite rule applied to response bodies.

Channel.description: A channel: a urlPattern plus the routes that requests matching it are forwarded to. Only `name` and `urlPattern` are required by the OpenHIM data model.

urlPattern.description: Regular expression matched against the incoming request path.

allow.description: Client roles allowed to use the channel.

whitelist.description: IP addresses allowed without client auth.

ChannelAudit.description: One patch in a channel's change history, recorded by the patch-history plugin.

Client.description: A system authorised to send messages through OpenHIM's router.

roles.description: Roles matched against a channel's `allow` list.

RolePermissions.description: Fine-grained permission flags on a role. `*-all` flags are booleans; `*-specified` flags are lists of ids.

Role.description: A named set of permissions. `admin`, `manager` and `operator` are created by default.

groups.description: Role names the user belongs to.

ContactUser.description: A contact inside a contact group.

user.description: Email address or MSISDN, depending on `method`.

ContactGroup.description: A named group of contacts that channel alerts notify.

TransactionRequest.description: The HTTP request of a transaction, route or orchestration.

TransactionResponse.description: The HTTP response of a transaction, route or orchestration.

ErrorDetails.description: An error captured while processing a transaction.

Orchestration.description: One upstream call a mediator made while handling a transaction.

RouteMetadata.description: The result of forwarding a transaction to one route.

Transaction.description: One message that passed through the OpenHIM router, with its request, response, routes and orchestrations.

TaskTransaction.description: One transaction queued inside a rerun task.

tid.description: Id of the transaction to rerun.

Task.description: A batch rerun task over a set of transactions.

user.description: Email of the user who created the task.

TaskCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a rerun task: either an explicit list of transaction ids or a filter.

filters.description: Transaction filter, when reruning by query rather than by id.

MediatorConfigDef.description: Definition of one configurable mediator parameter.

Mediator.description: A registered mediator: an external service that transforms or orchestrates messages for OpenHIM.

App.description: A console portal application (internal page, external link or ES module).

EventLink.description: A visualizer component bound to a channel, route or orchestration event.

Event.description: A fine-grained, short-lived transaction event used by the visualiser and alerting (expires after an hour).

Audit.description: An IHE ATNA audit record held in OpenHIM's audit repository.

rawMessage.description: The raw ATNA message as received.

AuditFilterOptions.description: The distinct codes present in the audit repository, for building filter drop-downs.

Certificate.description: An X.509 certificate held in the keystore.

Metric.description: Aggregated transaction metrics for one bucket (overall, per channel, or per time-series interval).

_id.description: Bucket key: the channel and the calendar parts of the interval.

LogEntry.description: One server log line from the Winston MongoDB transport.

Heartbeat.description: Server uptime plus the last-known uptime of every registered mediator.

mediators.description: Mediator URN to uptime in seconds, or null when no heartbeat arrived in the last minute.

now.description: Server time in milliseconds since the epoch.

AuthenticationResult.description: The authenticated user and a session cookie.

MetadataExport.description: A full metadata export: every configuration collection in one document.

MetadataImportResult.description: The outcome of importing or validating one metadata document.

KeystoreValidity.description: Whether the server certificate and private key match.

ImportMap.description: An ES module import map assembled from the registered `esmodule` apps.
